title: membrane-rule-audit: Biological audits of protein variant-effect scores
description: membrane-rule-audit is a Python toolkit for assessing whether protein variant-effect scores reflect specified biological expectations. It provides audits for positive-inside preferences, disulfide loss, and proline introduction in transmembrane helices, together with tools for fitting and applying annotation-based score adjustments. The package provides command-line interfaces, synthetic examples, and optional Biopython SeqRecord integration for the positive-inside audit. Audit outputs include contrasts, contributing counts, and uncertainty intervals when the required groups are available.
